items.title: The bivariant action of a closed subscheme family on a cycle is the cycle of the fibred product
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file relative-cycles.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: 10 行陈述（4 行证明）、闭子概形族对素循环的作用 = 纤维积循环：action-coherent 特例归约（F=O_Z/G=O_W，张量即纤维积结构层），层等同定义性（软点注记）。3 处引用全具名，无 omit，收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-action-closed (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2431-2440

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The closed subscheme family [Z/X/Y]_r is the module family of O_Z and the prime cycle [W]_e is the module family of O_W, and the tensor product O_Z tensor f^* O_W is the structure sheaf of Z x_Y W, so the coherent action lemma applied to these sheaves gives exactly the claimed fibred product cycle (source lines 2442-2445)
